raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "in-plane design domain",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 refers to Fig. 1 without specifying boundary coordinates, beam length, height, or aspect ratio. Sec. 4's directional hexagon counts do not determine those dimensions.",
      "readings": [
        "Straight rectangular domain [0,2] x [0,1]",
        "Straight rectangular domain [0,3] x [0,1]",
        "Domain follows the stepped outer boundary of complete hexagons rather than a straight rectangular envelope"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 specifies a two-dimensional beam but gives no thickness or unit-thickness convention. Uniform thickness scales stiffness for a fixed total point force.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t=1 in the chosen length units",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.01 in the same length units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "concentrated force at the lower-right corner",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 and the Fig. 1 caption specify the force location but give no components or angle; the loading schematic is unavailable.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical downward force: Fx=0, Fy=-F",
        "Horizontal rightward force: Fx=F, Fy=0",
        "Force directed 45 degrees downward and rightward"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "concentrated force at the lower-right corner",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 2.1, the Fig. 1 caption, nor Sec. 4 gives the force magnitude. The reported compliance does not uniquely recover it.",
      "readings": [
        "Force magnitude F=1 in consistent force units",
        "Force magnitude F=1000 in the same force units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "non-design regions near the support and force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1, 2.2, and 4 do not explicitly state whether passive regions exist or provide their masks.",
      "readings": [
        "All elements are designable; no passive regions",
        "A one-cell solid patch adjoining the loaded lower-right corner",
        "A one-cell-wide solid strip along the left support plus a one-cell solid patch at the loaded corner"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "single-material volume limit",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (1) introduces V_fm, but no numerical V_f1 is supplied for the M=1 extended SIMP result in Table 2.",
      "readings": [
        "V_f1=0.3",
        "V_f1=0.4",
        "V_f1=0.5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "density field used to evaluate material volume",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (1) leaves V(x) undefined. Sec. 2.2.1 explicitly assigns projected densities to stiffness interpolation but does not specify which density field enters the volume constraint.",
      "readings": [
        "V=sum_e v_e*x_e using raw design variables",
        "V=sum_e v_e*tilde_x_e using filtered variables",
        "V=sum_e v_e*x_phys_e using projected physical variables"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "single-material phase assignment and void stiffness",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Table 1 gives phase 1 modulus 1 and void modulus 10^-9, consistent with Eq. (4)'s nonzero void floor. Eq. (14) instead starts its phase sequence at zero and reverses the stiffness ordering. Its phase count and mapping to the M=1 solid and void are not reconciled.",
      "readings": [
        "Follow Table 1 and Eq. (4): normalized E_1=1 and E_min=10^-9",
        "Follow Eq. (14) literally with two phases including void: normalized solid modulus 1 and void modulus 0"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3 and Table 1 specify Young's moduli but provide no Poisson's ratio needed to construct the two-dimensional elastic constitutive matrix.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform Poisson's ratio nu=0.25",
        "Uniform Poisson's ratio nu=0.30",
        "Uniform Poisson's ratio nu=0.33"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 calls the beam two-dimensional, but neither it nor the stiffness formulation specifies plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP penalization exponent",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (4) introduces p, but Sec. 4 provides neither its value nor a penalization continuation policy.",
      "readings": [
        "p=3 throughout",
        "p=4 throughout",
        "Continue p through 1, 2, and 3 during optimization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter-radius units and neighborhood metric",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4 gives r_fill=4, while Sec. 2.2.1 does not define its length unit, distance metric, or conversion from the hexagonal mesh to the target structured grid.",
      "readings": [
        "Euclidean centroid distance with radius four structured-grid cell widths",
        "Euclidean centroid distance with radius four original hexagon edge lengths",
        "Euclidean centroid distance with radius four beam-coordinate units",
        "Manhattan cell-index distance with a radius of four cells"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density-filter weights",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (2) defines the normalized weighted average but never defines W_ej. Calling the filter classical does not supply an explicit kernel.",
      "readings": [
        "Conical weights W_ej=max(0,r-d_ej)",
        "Uniform weights W_ej=1 inside the radius",
        "Truncated Gaussian weights W_ej=exp(-(d_ej/r)^2) inside the radius"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "projection continuation schedule",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4 fixes beta's starting value at 1 and maximum at 32, but does not give intermediate values, update intervals, or advancement criteria.",
      "readings": [
        "Use beta=1,2,4,8,16,32, doubling every 50 iterations",
        "Use beta=1,2,4,8,16,32, doubling every 100 iterations",
        "Use the same doubling sequence, advancing when maximum design-variable change falls below 0.01"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "conversion of the stated hexagonal mesh to a structured grid",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies 120 by 60 hexagonal elements through HoneyMesher. It gives no equivalent structured-grid resolution or rule for preserving physical spacing, element area, or displacement DoFs.",
      "readings": [
        "Use 120 by 60 rectangular cells by copying the directional counts",
        "Choose a uniform rectangular grid matching the hexagonal mesh's physical cell-center spacings",
        "Choose a uniform rectangular grid matching the hexagonal mesh's total displacement DoF count"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "finite-element stiffness formulation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 4 identify hexagonal finite elements but provide no shape functions, integration rule, or stiffness-equivalent formulation for the target structured grid.",
      "readings": [
        "Bilinear Q4 rectangular elements with 2-by-2 Gauss integration",
        "Biquadratic Q9 rectangular elements with 3-by-3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial design-variable field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The optimization formulation and Sec. 4 do not specify the starting density field.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform x_e=V_f1",
        "Uniform x_e=1",
        "Alternating x_e=V_f1-0.01 and V_f1+0.01, clipped to the stated bounds"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA move limits and asymptote settings",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The abstract and introduction identify MMA, but Sec. 4's statement that parameters are kept the same supplies no move limits or asymptote parameters.",
      "readings": [
        "Move limit 0.2; initial asymptote distance 0.5 of the variable range; expansion 1.2 and contraction 0.7",
        "Move limit 0.1; initial asymptote distance 0.1 of the variable range; expansion 1.1 and contraction 0.7"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "optimization termination",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 provides no convergence criterion, feasibility tolerance, maximum iteration count, or required convergence at the final projection sharpness.",
      "readings": [
        "At beta=32, stop when maximum design-variable change is below 0.01 and volume violation is below 10^-4",
        "At beta=32, stop when relative compliance change is below 10^-6 and volume violation is below 10^-6",
        "Stop after 500 iterations, with the continuation schedule arranged to reach beta=32"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "numerical equilibrium solution",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (1) specifies K U=F but gives no linear-solver method or accuracy tolerance for reproducing the numerical optimization trajectory.",
      "readings": [
        "Sparse direct factorization",
        "Jacobi-preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 10^-8",
        "Jacobi-preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 10^-4"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
